title: Unified Agent compose runtime wiring
objective: Route outline workbench and home compose paths through the unified Agent runtime with real SKILL guidance injection.

codeChanges.summary: Compose builds workspace skill guidance and calls askPlainAi with guidance, skillIds, promptSource, and resumed budget; chain entry has a mode guard.
Home compose builds workspace skill guidance and passes it through callApi to createAgentDialogueRuntime; chain execution is explicitly guarded.

verification.command: npx vitest run src/services/workspaceSkillEngine.spec.ts src/services/agentDialogueRuntime.spec.ts src/services/agentOrchestrator.spec.ts --reporter=verbose

lineageAudit.compose: Unified Agent runtime; SKILL guidance injected as system guidance only.
lineageAudit.chain: Legacy workspace skill engine retained by design for sequential chain execution.
lineageAudit.finalDraft: Final-draft runner retained; guidance continues through its dedicated path.

scopeNotes: No tool surface, permission semantics, batch protocol, or EditTask state machine changes.
SKILL guidance is advisory prompt text and does not alter execution protocol.
Real Electron and live API validation are Phase E follow-up and are not claimed here.
